scope: Native optional chromatic aberration correction within pixel-shift synthesis

official_option.label: Chromatic aberration correction
official_option.description: Select On to reduce lateral color aberration.

implementation.pipeline: Reconstruct uncropped RGB, sample the final crop through red/blue radial maps, preserve green unchanged.
implementation.coordinates: Use the uncropped reconstructed plane coordinate system, including taps outside the final crop.
implementation.parameters: Signed 32-bit Q8 center offsets and two Q20 coefficient triples from source Nikon metadata.
implementation.memory: Float64 temporaries are limited to 64-row blocks. The uncropped reconstruction and final cropped RGB remain resident during correction.
implementation.boundary: Truncate source coordinates toward zero, skip out-of-domain taps without renormalization, clamp to 14 bits, then truncate sample values.
implementation.extreme_metadata: Coordinates outside the cubic kernel's support are set to zero without casting extreme coordinates to int64.

saved_vendor_comparison.coverage: Synthetic independently varying RAWs, nonzero ordered sparse selectors, inherited coefficients in all modes and signed centers/all six nonzero coefficients in 4/16-frame modes.

limitations: Synthetic saved vendor agreement is not authentic capture quality or Lightroom acceptance.
Extreme coefficient behavior is an input-safety contract, not vendor parity evidence for those parameters.
Full-resolution correction runtime and memory still require measurement.
The CLI correction option is not yet connected at this checkpoint.
